characters.role: Represents authoring decisions and owns Story, ttsChunks and Scene creation without impersonating the user.
characters.silhouette: Rounded ink figure with a coral pencil tab on the left shoulder.
invariants: Appears only beside an authored input or creative construction step.
Has no facial emotion tags; posture and panel timing carry emphasis.

characters.role: Represents deterministic mechanical checks, fingerprints and invalidation evidence.
characters.silhouette: Angular ink figure with one blue square lens and a checksum card.
invariants: Appears only with a concrete input identity or mechanical result.
A passing state is blue; a stale state is coral and visibly crossed out.

forbidden: No mascot branding, customer avatar or testimonial role.
No photoreal face, copied character design or external character asset.
No character mouth movement pretending to be the sealed narrator.
